svg.title: XiangShan AI (XSAI) Kunminghu V2R2A architecture
svg.desc: Per-core control pipeline, Mx dimension state, matrix instruction commit and synchronization, MLSU, private HBL2, and CUTE task control, loaders, AB/C registers and memory interfaces. MTE is one Compute execution resource with an 8 by 8 PE array, connected directly to tr and acc. CUTE memory traffic reaches private HBL2 through LocalMMU and Cute2TL; HBL2 retains its CHI interface.
